en.shortDescription: Open-source headless CMS built with Node.js
en.longDescription:
Strapi is a flexible headless CMS for building APIs and content-rich applications.

Uses the community naskio/strapi image (Strapi does not publish an official pre-built image). Includes PostgreSQL — JWT secrets use SERVICE_BASE64_32_STRAPI, SERVICE_HEX_64_STRAPI, SERVICE_BASE64_64_STRAPI, and SERVICE_PASSWORD_64_STRAPI.
